turns.question: In sessions between 20 September and 3 October 2026 that had both an add-to-cart and a checkout, what was the median number of minutes from the first add-to-cart to the checkout?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric for the median number of minutes from add-to-cart to checkout, so I cannot give that figure. The closest metrics are cart_to_checkout_rate (share of site sessions with an add to cart that checked out on the add to cart's day or the day after), cart_sessions and checkout_sessions, but none of them measures minutes. No query was run, so there is no freshness statement to quote.
